info.title: Aion DPS partner API
info.description:
Read-only static game data of AION 2 (names, places, times) and a few site feeds, for other community sites. No players, characters or fights.

Call it from your server, not from a visitor's browser (the key would be public), and cache the answers for 5 to 60 minutes. Each key has its own requests-per-minute limit; over it the answer is 429 with Retry-After.

Game names come from the AION 2 client; AION 2 and its names, texts and artwork belong to NCSOFT. Please name aiondps.com as the source and link it.

This description itself is served without a key at /api/partner/v1/openapi.json.

get.description: How to get from an instance to the item ids that drop: /instances lists the instances (slug), /bosses?instance=<slug> their bosses, /bosses/{slug} one boss with its loot per dungeon mode (every drop has an itemId), /items/{id} the tooltip of an item. To get a whole instance in one request use /bosses?instance=<slug>&loot=1: every boss that has loot then comes in the shape of /bosses/{slug}. Every mode of an expedition is a boss of its own (exploration, conquest, conquest-hard), so the list holds one entry per mode.

modes.description: Per mode (for example explore): minLevel, itemLevel, players, weeklyTries.

hasLoot.description: The boss has a loot list; fetch it with /bosses/{slug}.

respawnHours.description: Hours until the boss is back after a kill; null when the game gives no fixed value.
Hours until the boss is back after a kill; null when the game gives no fixed value.

instanceDropCount.description: Number of monsters of instances, sanctuary raids and the Abyss that drop this pet's soul (see instanceDrops of the pet's detail).

spawns.description: Maps with the places of those monsters, in the game's own coordinates.

map.description: Includes the open-world maps Verteron, Altgard and the Reshanta maps.

monsters.description: The same points by monster. boss is true for the bosses of instances, worldBoss for field and world bosses; a monster with neither is a normal mob that drops the soul.

instanceDrops.description: Monsters of expeditions, transcendence dungeons, sanctuary raids and the Abyss whose loot has this pet's soul. Since the patch of 2026-11-04 normal monsters of the instances drop souls too (before only bosses). The soul is bound; the drop chance is decided by the game server.

instance.description: Slug of the instance (see /instances); null for the Abyss.

mode.description: Expedition step; null where there are no steps.

body.description: The text of the notes as structured by the site.

ItemDetail.description: One item as the in-game tooltip shows it. Equipment carries the stat blocks and sockets; other items only the general fields.

boundOnPickup.description: Bound to the looting character at once (all dungeon loot). Crafted equipment is not: it can be sold and traded in the server storage until a character equips it and it binds to the soul.

mainStats.description: Base stats of the piece (equipment only).

unit.description: percent = the value is a percentage (8.2 = 8.2 %).

maxBlock.description: The block caps the client keeps apart from the base stats (equipment only).

unit.description: percent = the value is a percentage (8.2 = 8.2 %).

soulBind.description: What the first soul binding rolls: firstBindStats of the possibleStats (each within min..max) and firstBindSkills skills.

soulFuse.description: Soul Fuse (Seelenbindung in the German client) is possible.

labels.description: The client's own tooltip captions in the language asked for (requiredLevel, soulBindRate, soulBindFirst, manaStoneSlot ...).

allOf.description: One boss with the loot of the game's possible-reward window. Every mode of an expedition is a boss of its own (exploration, conquest, conquest-hard ...) with its own loot.

rolls.description: The rolls ("random obtain 1..n"): chance of the roll in percent, how many times it is made, and the items of the roll.

chance.description: Single chance of the item within its roll, in percent.

guaranteed.description: Guaranteed items after the given number of runs.

BossSchedule.description: When the boss appears on a fixed time (European clock). kind weekly: on the days (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday) at the time `at`; kind cycle: every `everyMinutes` from `base`. openMinutes is how long it stays reachable.

kina.description: Kina the exchange costs besides the items.

BadLang.description: Unsupported lang (unsupported_lang); the answer lists the languages there are.

RateLimited.description: Over the key's limit; wait Retry-After seconds.
